description: This file defines the 'Style' class responsible for parsing and processing style information from XML data in the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically for reading style-related XML nodes and attributes.

classes.name: Style
classes.description: A class for parsing style-related XML nodes, such as alignment, borders, fonts, fill, number formats, and protection, into internal representations for spreadsheet styling.

methods.name: parseStyles
methods.description: Parses the styles XML element, extracting various style components (alignment, border, font, fill, number format, protection) and storing them in the internal styles array.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves attributes from a given SimpleXMLElement, returning an empty SimpleXMLElement if input is null.

methods.name: getSxml
methods.description: Ensures a SimpleXMLElement is returned, creating an empty one if the input is null.
